note: City of San Diego campground in Mission Trails Regional Park near Santee, beside small Kumeyaay Lake. RVs, campervans and trailers may use only sites 20, 22 and 24-45 and 47; 21 of those have parking 23 ft or longer (29, 39, 41 and 47 are 19-22 ft). Generators only at sites 35-42 and 44, mid-September to mid-March. RVs over 10 years old must pass inspection. --Claude
summary: Kumeyaay Lake (City of San Diego / MTRP): mtrp.org pages + 2019 rules PDF + SD RecConnect (ActiveNet) site records + imagery. Keep. Confirmed $24 (one page says $22.78), 46 sites, no hookups; filled booking (ActiveNet, 180-day window, 2-day cutoff, 3-night max), showers/dump, weekend-only year-round, max 46 ft. Not waterfront stands (lake ~2 ha behind brush). Phone and website flags.
flags: PHONE: stored 619-668-3281 is the MTRP Visitor Center -> 619-668-2748 (Kumeyaay Lake Campground, posted on mtrp.org/campground and SD RecConnect).

WEBSITE: stored https://mtrp.org/kumeyaay-lake-campground/ now redirects to a news post -> https://mtrp.org/campground/ (add the booking link https://anc.apm.activecommunities.com/sdparkandrec/reservation/search?onlineSiteId=0&from_original_cui=true&online=true&locale=en-US).
FEES CONFLICT: mtrp.org/reservations says $24 a night, mtrp.org/campground says $22.78; kept $24 (two pages) and noted both. ActiveNet's public API did not expose the fee.

FIT: RVs only on 25 named sites; 21 have 23-46 ft parking (20, 22, 24-28, 30-38, 40, 42-45). Sites 29 (19 ft), 39 (20), 41 (21), 47 (22) are short. Rules: RVs older than 10 years must pass inspection (a 2023 rig passes until 2033).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Kumeyaay Lake is two small ponds (roughly 2 ha together on imagery, near the ~5-acre pond line) north of the loops beyond brush and trees; only Site 03 (ADA-only, tent, 21 ft) is described 'Within 100 feet of lake'.
